verified_interactions: Real four-spell opening and real six-spell follow-up combat reach player idle; temporary introduction ends naturally.
All46 spells resolve artwork, twelve real equipment definitions use painted images, nine stat glyphs and five doctrine emblems plus Achilles load.
Unknown route presentation never leaks its real kind; inspected combat map leaves run snapshot unchanged.
Actual engine mouse events hover and click pause Options to toggle reduced motion and restore it; actual hit-target geometry remains fixed.
Inventory action footer remains visible before scrolling and stationary while details scroll; actual mouse click equips selected weapon and returns replaced weapon to inventory.
Themes, icons, action parents and presentation restore outside Catabase; reduced motion disables active motion including inventory tile zoom.
Each of four/six spell-button rectangles is disjoint from Move, EndTurn, three navigation buttons and all other spells; no horizontal viewport overflow across21 main views per resolution.
Explicit result fixtures cover victory/defeat with real result scene and restoration of another adventure.
issues_found_and_corrected: StyleBox sentinel margins expanded inventory; effective margins now preserved.
Missing metadata on first motion binding generated engine errors; has_meta guards added.
Inventory Equip action was below the long description; existing actions moved to a reversible fixed footer.
Legacy pause zoom moved its click target; Catabase motion keeps scale=1.
Six-spell HUD overlapped Move and EndTurn at1280; final slot sizing fits the actual ability region, with71 overlap assertions added.
limitations: Runtime shutdown diagnostics remain in combat-containing scenarios. Functional checks pass, but these exits are not reported as clean.
Intermediate victories, discoveries and twelve equipment grants in the UI probe are explicit fixtures. Only BattleFlowProbe plays the full opening victory.
Result screens are explicit fixtures and do not represent playing the final boss.
Only1280x720 and1920x1080 were visually validated. No claim of full20-room manual playthrough or balance validation.

No full parent runtime baseline was executed; other failures are not all individually attributed.
